rules: Founders hold supreme Dominion authority in standard context.
Copied appearance does not grant Founder identity or authority.
A Vorta may negotiate only within actual authority/mission scope.
Unit, First/subordinate role and command relationship require live assignment state.
Ketracel distribution is a resource/logistics interface, not AI narrative convenience.

organizations.display_name: Estados miembros o subordinados del Dominio
organizations.instance_model: Each polity remains its own entity with a dated relationship to the Dominion.
rules: Dominion membership/subordination is temporal and does not erase local government identity.

ai_guardrails: Do not infer authority from species alone.
Do not let a Changeling copied form inherit Founder permissions.
Do not invent Vorta mission authority, Jem'Hadar orders or ketracel allocations.
